firstAnswers.prompt: The joint table is [3,0]; [0,1]. Either label determines the other perfectly, and H(X) = H(Y) is approximately 0.811278 bits. What is I(X;Y)?
The joint counts are X1: [3,1] and X2: [1,3]. After you learn that the drawn card has X1, what is P(Y2 given X1)?
A box contains 8 cards. The counts for (X1,Y1), (X1,Y2), (X2,Y1), (X2,Y2) are 3, 1, 1, 3. One card is drawn uniformly. What is P(X1 and Y2)?
A joint-count table has rows X1: [2, 1, 1] and X2: [0, 2, 2], with columns Y1, Y2, Y3. Which calculation gives P(Y2)?
Every joint count in a finite card box is multiplied by 5. Cards are still drawn uniformly. What changes in the normalized joint distribution?
Four equally likely X labels map to Y groups: X1 and X2 always carry Y1; X3 and X4 always carry Y2. Which pair of conditional entropies is correct?
For rows [8,0] and [1,1], Y has marginal probabilities 9/10 and 1/10, so H(Y) is about 0.469 bits. Observing X2 makes Y evenly split, with entropy 1 bit. Which statement is correct?
X has four named categories, but all 7 cards carry X1; the other category counts are zero. What is H(X)?
X takes two labels with probabilities 3/4 and 1/4. Which expression is its entropy in bits?
A fictional investigator enters 40 classroom observations as joint counts and obtains positive mutual information. What does this calculation establish by itself?
The only populated pairs are (X1,Y2) and (X2,Y1), with one card each. Which interpretation is justified?
A box has joint rows X1: [8,0] and X2: [1,1]. Given X1, Y is certain; given X2, Y is a fair two-label variable. What is the average conditional entropy H(Y|X)?
A table has rows [1,2] and [2,4]. Each row has Y proportions 1/3 and 2/3. What follows for this authored finite distribution?

Rows [998,999] and [997,998] have a tiny mutual information that can round to 0.000000 bits. For cell (X1,Y1), count times total is 3,984,016, while row total times column total is 3,984,015. What should the explorer conclude?
Using base-2 surprisal, -log2(p), an outcome has probability 1/8. How much surprisal is attached to that outcome?
For rows [3,1] and [1,3], the pair (X1,Y2) has p = 1/8, while P(X1)P(Y2) = 1/4. What is this cell's contribution p log2[p/(P(X1)P(Y2))] to mutual information?
